TanStack Router useSearch from route.description:
Read this route's validated search params inside its own component. Requires the Route exported by the route module.

在路由自身的组件中读取已校验的 search 参数；需要该路由模块导出的 Route。

TanStack Router useSearch by route id.description:
Read a route's search params from a component that lives outside that route module. Requires useSearch from @tanstack/react-router.

在路由模块之外的组件中读取某个路由的 search 参数；需要 @tanstack/react-router 的 useSearch。

TanStack Router useSearch with select.description:
Subscribe to one search field so the component re-renders only when that field changes. Requires the Route exported by the route module.

只订阅一个 search 字段，组件仅在该字段变化时重渲染；需要该路由模块导出的 Route。

TanStack Router search updater on Link.description:
Update one search param while keeping the rest, staying on the current route. Requires Link from @tanstack/react-router.

停留在当前路由，更新单个 search 参数并保留其余参数；需要 @tanstack/react-router 的 Link。

TanStack Router navigate with search upd.description:
Change search params programmatically without leaving the route; the route's own navigate keeps the search type. Requires the Route exported by the route module.

不离开当前路由，以编程方式修改 search 参数；路由自身的 navigate 保留 search 的类型；需要该路由模块导出的 Route。
